title: Sentinel SN-024 Harness Telemetry Example
description: Module-local example panels. Case/action/model/evaluation versions belong in traces, not Prometheus labels. Financial audit is a separate unsampled ledger view. Fixture exports never imply deployed observations.

options.content: Search traces by `case_id`, `action_id`, `model.version`, `evaluation.version`, and `audit.event_key` span attributes. Do not promote those identifiers to metric labels. Open the action-ledger financial audit for unsampled monetary outcomes. Fixture dashboards are not deployed evidence.
